Why Small Models Win

Maria Lindqvist and Jonas Berg · Mar 7, 2024
Share

Every few months a bigger model arrives, and every few months someone quietly ships a small one that does the job better. This essay is about why that keeps happening, written as a fixture with enough words to be taken as a post.

The cost of size

Larger models cost more to train, to serve and to understand. The last of these is the one that matters most when something goes wrong in production and you need to know why.

What to do instead

  1. Start with the smallest model that could work.
  2. Measure before you scale.

That is the whole argument, more or less, and it fits in a few paragraphs.
